decisions.reason: The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine builds directly on the firm's core precast automation know-how and its own R&D, and it is a product line with several models, so the firm can interpret early results and refine it rather than withdraw it, although the recent removal of the robot products shows the portfolio is reorganised frequently.

The production analysis software sits close to the firm's established control and software offer, and in-house engineering and R&D give the firm the related knowledge to assimilate feedback and improve it as part of its push toward digital, automated precast production.
